authoritative_input: Frozen Decoder Enforcement Contract only; do not derive from raw schema
fail_closed: Reject unknown predicate, unresolved scope, duplicate predicate or omitted source row; no approximation
inclusion_argument: Each object has exactly the required declared keys; sorting them changes no values.
Each enum has its exact literal spelling.
Every finite mathematical integer has signed decimal integer spelling.
Every semantic string has a JSON spelling using ordinary Unicode or short/Unicode escapes, including control characters, supplementary characters and escaped surrogate code units.
Unbounded array recursion preserves all finite lengths including zero.
Induction over this finite contract tree establishes V_contract subseteq V_regex; no validator-only predicate is introduced.

mapping.additionalProperties: Closed declared key list; no unknown or duplicate fields
mapping.enum: Exact escaped JSON literal alternatives from contract enum values
mapping.properties: Recursively render each declared property scope once
mapping.required: All listed fields occur exactly once; require declared keys equal required keys for this contract
mapping.type_array_and_items: Brackets with zero-or-more recursively rendered elements separated by commas; no length/uniqueness/contains conditions
mapping.type_integer: Optional minus followed by zero or nonzero decimal digit and zero-or-more decimal digits; mathematical integer values retain a canonical representation; no magnitude/range limits
mapping.type_object: Literal braces and all declared required fields in lexical field-name order; no extra fields; reject if the contract has unsupported optional structure
mapping.type_string: Quoted zero-or-more ordinary characters excluding raw quote, backslash, U+0000-U+001F; or backslash followed by a JSON short escape or u plus exactly four hex digits
mapping.whitespace: Only JSON whitespace [space TAB CR LF], zero-or-more at every token boundary and document edges

post_freeze: No regex/rule/contract edits or tuning after structural outcomes; candidate errors distinct from rejection; no recovery following environment mutation failure.
serialization: SEMANTICALLY_NEUTRAL_SERIALIZATION_RESTRICTION: lexical property order, literal canonical keys/enums and canonical integer spelling; preserve every semantic value at least once
